name: Point-NeRF
definition: A rendering method that synthesizes novel views by aggregating features from K neighboring neural points in a 3D point cloud to compute view-dependent radiance and volume density at shading locations along rays, avoiding empty space sampling.
summary: Point-NeRF is a point-based Neural Radiance Field that synthesizes novel views by aggregating features from a sparse 3D neural point cloud, offering significantly faster training than grid-based NeRF.
